1.zh: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。
1.en: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

1.zh: 耶和华是忌邪施报的神。耶和华施报大有忿怒；向他的敌人施报，向他的仇敌怀怒。
1.en: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The Lord takes vengeance on his foes and maintains his wrath against his enemies.

1.zh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力，万不以有罪的为无罪。他乘旋风和暴风而来，云彩为他脚下的尘土。
1.en: The Lord is slow to anger and great in power; the Lord will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.

1.zh: 他斥责海，使海干了，使一切江河干涸。巴珊和迦密的树林衰残；利巴嫩的花草也衰残了。
1.en: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

1.zh: 大山因他震动；小山也都消化。大地在他面前突起；世界和住在其间的也都如此。
1.en: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.

1.zh: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？他的忿怒如火倾倒；磐石因他崩裂。
1.en: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.

1.zh: 耶和华本为善，在患难的日子为人的保障，并且认得那些投靠他的人。
1.en: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

1.zh: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微，又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。
1.en: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh ; he will pursue his foes into darkness.

1.zh: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？他必将你们灭绝净尽；灾难不再兴起。
1.en: Whatever they plot against the Lord he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.

1.zh: 你们像丛杂的荆棘，像喝醉了的人，又如枯干的碎秸全然烧灭。
1.en: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.

1.zh: 有一人从你那里出来，图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。
1.en: From you, O Nineveh , has one come forth who plots evil against the Lord and counsels wickedness.

1.zh: 耶和华如此说：尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多，也被剪除，归于无有。犹大啊，我虽然使你受苦，却不再使你受苦。
1.en: This is what the Lord says: "Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be cut off and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, O Judah , I will afflict you no more.

1.zh: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭，扭开他的绳索。
1.en: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away."

1.zh: 耶和华已经出令，指著尼尼微说：你名下的人必不留后；我必从你神的庙中除灭雕刻的偶像和铸造的偶像；我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。
1.en: The Lord has given a command concerning you, Nineveh : "You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the carved images and cast idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile."

1.zh: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，说：犹大啊，可以守你的节期，还你所许的愿吧！因为那恶人不再从你中间经过，他已灭绝净尽了。
1.en: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, O Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.

2.zh: 尼尼微啊，那打碎邦国的上来攻击你。你要看守保障，谨防道路，使腰强壮，大大勉力。
2.en: An attacker advances against you,Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!

2.zh: 耶和华复兴雅各的荣华，好像以色列的荣华一样；因为使地空虚的，已经使雅各和以色列空虚，将他们的葡萄枝毁坏了。
2.en: The Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.

2.zh: 他勇士的盾牌是红的，精兵都穿朱红衣服。在他预备争战的日子，战车上的钢铁闪烁如火，柏木把的枪也抡起来了。
2.en: The shields of his soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of pine are brandished.

2.zh: 车辆在街上（或译：城外）急行，在宽阔处奔来奔去，形状如火把，飞跑如闪电。
2.en: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.

2.zh: 尼尼微王招聚他的贵胄；他们步行绊跌，速上城墙，预备挡牌。
2.en: He summons his picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.
The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

2.zh: 王后蒙羞，被人掳去；宫女捶胸，哀鸣如鸽。此乃命定之事。
2.en: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away. Its slave girls moan like doves and beat upon their breasts.

2.zh: 尼尼微自古以来充满人民，如同聚水的池子；现在居民却都逃跑。虽有人呼喊说：站住！站住！却无人回顾。
2.en: Nineveh is like a pool, and its water is draining away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one turns back.

2.zh: 你们抢掠金银罢！因为所积蓄的无穷，华美的宝器无数。
2.en: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!

2.zh: 尼尼微现在空虚荒凉，人心消化，双膝相碰，腰都疼痛，脸都变色。
2.en: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.

2.zh: 狮子的洞和少壮狮子喂养之处在哪里呢？公狮母狮小狮游行 、 无人惊吓之地在哪里呢？
2.en: Where now is the lions' den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?

2.zh: 公狮为小狮撕碎许多食物，为母狮掐死活物，把撕碎的 、 掐死的充满他的洞穴。
2.en: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.

2.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌，必将你的车辆焚烧成烟，刀剑也必吞灭你的少壮狮子。我必从地上除灭你所撕碎的，你使者的声音必不再听见。
2.en: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard."

3.zh: 祸哉！这流人血的城，充满谎诈和强暴，抢夺的事总不止息。
3.en: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies,full of plunder, never without victims!

3.zh: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰，马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，
3.en: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!

3.zh: 马兵争先，刀剑发光，枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多，尸首成了大堆，尸骸无数，人碰著而跌倒，
3.en: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses-

3.zh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，惯行邪术，藉淫行诱惑列国，用邪术诱惑（原文是卖）多族。
3.en: all because of the wanton lust of a harlot, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.

3.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌；我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上，使列国看见你的赤体，使列邦观看你的丑陋。
3.en: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

3.zh: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上，辱没你，为众目所观。
3.en: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.

3.zh: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你，说：尼尼微荒凉了！有谁为你悲伤呢？我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？
3.en: All who see you will flee from you and say, 'Nineveh is in ruins-who will mourn for her?' Where can I find anyone to comfort you?"

3.zh: 你岂比挪亚们（或）强呢？挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水；海（指尼罗河）作他的濠沟，又作他的城墙。
3.en: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.

3.zh: 古实和埃及是他无穷的力量；弗人和路比族是他的帮手。
3.en: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

3.zh: 但他被迁移，被掳去；他的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。人为他的尊贵人拈阄；他所有的大人都被炼子锁著。
3.en: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.

3.zh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏，并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。
3.en: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

3.zh: 你一切保障必像无花果树上初熟的无花果，若一摇撼就落在想吃之人的口中。
3.en: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.

3.zh: 你地上的人民如同妇女；你国中的关口向仇敌敞开；你的门闩被火焚烧。
3.en: Look at your troops- they are all women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed their bars.

3.zh: 你要打水预备受困；要坚固你的保障，踹土和泥，修补砖窑。
3.en: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

3.zh: 在那里，火必烧灭你；刀必杀戮你，吞灭你如同蝻子。任你加增人数多如蝻子，多如蝗虫罢！
3.en: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and, like grasshoppers, consume you. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!

3.zh: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星；蝻子吃尽而去。
3.en: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more than the stars of the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.

3.zh: 你的首领多如蝗虫；你的军长彷佛成群的蚂蚱，天凉的时候齐落在篱笆上，日头一出便都飞去，人不知道落在何处。
3.en: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day- but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.

3.zh: 亚述王啊，你的牧人睡觉；你的贵胄安歇；你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。
3.en: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.

3.zh: 你的损伤无法医治；你的伤痕极其重大。凡听你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的恶谁没有时常遭遇呢？
3.en: Nothing can heal your wound; your injury is fatal.
